events.title: Jason Fitzgerald — Unearthed (exhibition)
events.location: Jan Murphy Gallery, 486 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley QLD
events.description: A contemporary art exhibition showcasing new works by Jason Fitzgerald, exploring themes of discovery and form. The gallery provides an intimate space for viewing high-quality contemporary Australian art.

events.title: Celia Gullett — Spirit into Matter (exhibition)
events.location: Jan Murphy Gallery, 486 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley QLD
events.description: An exhibition by Celia Gullett focusing on the interplay between abstract concepts and physical materials. It offers a reflective experience for those interested in the intersections of philosophy and artistic practice.

events.title: New Farm Queer Film Festival
events.location: New Farm Cinemas, 701 Brunswick St, New Farm QLD
events.source: Five Star Cinemas / New Farm Queer Film Festival
events.description: A curated selection of queer cinema featuring independent, experimental, and thought-provoking films. The historic venue hosts a community of cinephiles interested in cultural storytelling.

events.title: Interpreting archives: stories on the page, stories between the lines
events.location: Anzac Square Memorial Galleries, 285 Ann Street, Brisbane QLD
events.source: Anzac Square Memorial Galleries / State Library of Queensland
events.description: A session exploring how to read historical archives beyond the surface, focusing on methodology and uncovering hidden narratives. Ideal for history enthusiasts interested in research and primary source analysis.
